Products & Packaging

Atomic Packs. Three Add-ons. Five Free Platform Engines.

Commerce = Commercial + Sales. People = HR + Recruitment + Workforce + Payroll. Never split. Add-ons have hard dependencies. Platform infra is always free.

Core Products

Two Atomic Packs + Three Standalone Products

Atomic packs share tables and RBAC — they cannot be purchased separately. Standalone products integrate via the shared foundation.

Commerce

Atomic Pack — Never Split

Hard FKs, shared tables, single pipeline. Commercial + Sales are one product because the handoff from lead to contract to revenue cannot afford a seam.

  • Pipeline & deal management
  • Agreements & orders
  • Renewal loop auto-creation
  • Expansion detection
  • Revenue attribution to source

People

Atomic Pack — 4 Gates, One Product

Four RBAC gates (HR, Recruitment, Workforce, Payroll) on shared employee records. Payroll runs from governed records, not disconnected handoffs.

  • Employee lifecycle (hire → retire)
  • Recruitment → onboarding flow
  • Bitemporal payroll history
  • Statutory compliance (EPF, ESI, GST)
  • Performance & compensation

Finance

Standalone Product

Append-only ledger, hash chains, tamper-evident by architecture. Finance emits events — invoice_overdue, payment_received, write_off — so intelligence sees cash flow.

  • Double-entry accounting
  • AR/AP with payment behavior tracking
  • Budget vs actuals
  • Hash chain audit trail
  • Multi-currency, multi-entity

Marketing

Standalone Product

Campaigns, email sequences, lead scoring. Email events (open/click/bounce) feed into intelligence when writer exists.

  • Multi-channel campaigns
  • Email sequences & tracking
  • Lead scoring (persisted)
  • Content library
  • Attribution to revenue

Operations

Standalone Product

Project delivery, resource planning, utilization. Connects to Finance for invoicing, to People for staffing.

  • Project lifecycle & milestones
  • Resource allocation & utilization
  • Time tracking & billing
  • Delivery health signals
  • Capacity planning

Add-Ons

Three Add-Ons — Hard Dependencies, Not Upsells

Each add-on has a hard FK to a core product. You cannot buy CX360 without Commerce. You cannot buy Equity without People. This is architectural, not commercial.

Marketing Agency

Add-on — Needs Commerce

Client workspaces, retainer management, agency-specific reporting. Hard FK to Commercial — cannot exist without Commerce.

Requires: Commerce
  • Multi-client workspaces
  • Retainer & project billing
  • Agency P&L per client
  • Client portal access
  • Resource sharing across clients

CX360

Add-on — Needs Commerce

Portfolio Radar, health scoring, interventions, action rail, calibrated churn risk. The customer record that connects commercial, finance, support, and success.

Requires: Commerce
  • Portfolio Radar (server-ranked)
  • Lifecycle state + health + delta
  • Measured interventions (+30d outcome)
  • Action rail (renewal, payment, case, suspend, NPS)
  • Calibrated churn risk (3 tiers)

Equity

Add-on — Needs People

Cap table, equity grants, vesting schedules, scenario modeling. Hard FK to People — employee records are the source of truth.

Requires: People
  • Cap table management
  • Grant lifecycle (approval → vest)
  • Scenario modeling (exit, dilution)
  • 409A valuation tracking
  • Employee equity portal
Platform Infrastructure

Five Engines — Free for Every Tenant. Always.

Approvals, Workflow, Tickets, Governance, Documents. Not a tier. Not a feature flag. The substrate every product runs on.

Approvals

Multi-step chains, role-based routing, SLA, audit trail

Workflow

Stage-based automation, cross-engine triggers, assignment registry

Tickets

Case types, SLA with pause states, breach notifications

Governance

Teams, roles, hierarchy as operating model, permissioned execution

Documents

Folders, versioning, expiry, approval workflow, quota

Always Included

Platform infra is not a product tier.

No feature flags — all engines enabled for every tenant
No upsell — platform infra is not a product tier
No seat limits — unlimited users within tenant
No usage caps — storage quota is configurable, not tiered
RBAC included — governance engine powers all access control
